newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen edging up on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen edging up on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to edge up on Wednesday on new accounts day buying, but overall sentiment will remain weak, with investors lying low before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget on June 14, dealers said.
"The index will gain slightly today, but trading will remain thin as investors are sidelined ahead of the budget," dealer Rony Byramjee said.

On Tuesday, the Karachi 100-share index fell 4.81 points, or 0.32 percent, to end at 1,499.73. Losers led gainers by 220 to 66. Turnover rose to 15.35 million shares from 13.22 million in the previous session.
